build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems with PBC and soft or hard kNN ranking
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a chunked radius graph for a single system to reduce peak memory during distance computation
compute_soft_ranks_single_segment: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment using vmap-compatible out-of-place operations
segment_argsort_vectorized: compute argsort within each segment using a vectorized cumsum trick instead of a Python loop
soft_rank_low_mem: calculate approximate soft rankings for soft kNN by truncating the distance matrix to k plus delta neighbors
